text_block_list.text:
Upon visiting Bubbly Land, I came across
Winning Ticket and the others tending to someone.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay!? You sprained your ankle, didn't you!
Here, hold onto my shoulder!!

Ouch! 
This pain is seriously too much to handle, man...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're hurting pretty bad...! 
I'll go call the park staff!

Hold up! I'm scheduled to dance on stage!
If the staff finds out, they'll pull the plug on me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wait... you're! Bubbly Land's
star, "Fuzzy"-san, aren't you!?

text_block_list.name: Fuzzy-san
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I'm the idol of the youth, "Fuzzy."
Even if my leg falls off, even if Flower Friday turns into overtime――
I gotta get up on that dance platform tonight!!
choice_data_list: Are you seriously planning to dance!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...U-Uoooooohhhn!
What an insanely cool way to liveーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Normally nobody could ever say 'even if my leg falls off'!
Treasuring the stage above all else...
Fuzzy-san, you're a true starーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wanna help you out, Fuzzy-san!
Could I please stand on stage in your place!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Count me in too! Fuzzy-san's always
giving us a groovy good time, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Fuzzy-san
text_block_list.text:
However... I can't just let you girls take such a grand stage
without any preparation!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Please let us! We'll make it an awesome stage
that entertains everyone, I promise!!

text_block_list.name: Fuzzy-san
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What... what bubbly, burning eyes!
I'm convinced... you girls can do this!!

text_block_list.name: Fuzzy-san
text_block_list.text: Tonight's stage is in your hands!!

After sending Fuzzy-san to the infirmary and heading towards the stage...
lively music came echoing out.
Winning Ticket and Maruzensky have already started dancing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeaaah! Everyboooodyーー!
Today is a special stageーー!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whoo-hoo~~!
Let's keep the fever going all the way to midnight!!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't Fuzzy-san performing?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Night at Bubbly Land is just getting started!
Let's get even more hyped uuuuupーー!!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Booo! What is that dancing!
Swap back to Fuzzy-san already!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... that's pretty harsh!
The atmosphere is getting heavy...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The real fun starts now, Maruzen-saaan!
Let's dance our hearts out!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hyahoo! Is everyone feeling the vibe~~!!
Let's go full throttleeeーーっ!!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Those two... just how long are they gonna dance?
Don't they care about tomorrow at all!

The two of them danced non-stop for over an hour.
The audience's perception seemed to start shifting!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! This is so much fuuun!
You all gotta get hyped up more too!!
We need way more feeeveeeerーーー!!!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Such reckless abandon! That's pure bubble era vibes!
Screw worrying about schedules and deadlinesーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
We did it, Ticket-chan!
The whole venue is about to become one!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
We're still just getting started!
Everyboooody! C'mooooon!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: HYAHOOOEY!!
(SPLAAAASHHH!!)

Twisting her body mid-air,
Winning Ticket made an acrobatic dive right into the pool!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Yeeaaahh-hoo!
That's so wicked cool!!

One after another, the spectators began diving in too!
Winning Ticket's passion had clearly reached them!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad everyone gave it their all!
Since we came all the way out here, we gotta enjoy it to the max!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My, what fan-focused comments.
Ticket-chan, you're practically a star yourself♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If you pour your whole heart into it, you can become anything!
And when that gets across to everyone――
it's the absolute best feeling evvver!!

As stand-ins, the two of them pumped up
Bubbly Land to the absolute peak!
